title: こころのはたらき
subtitle: Mind and Behavior
courseType:

Liberal Arts and Sciences Courses

educationalGoal: Our activities are based on the “Mind”. Psychology is a field which seeks a scientific understanding of the “Mind” behind our behavior from the individual to the social level. It is important for us to understand human activities. That is significant for our daily life. Students will understand our activities and experience from the perspectives of psychology. The aim of this course is to develop insight in to human activities.
advice: Students will listen to the lecture about each area of psychology as below: (1) The history of psychology, its area, and methodology (2) Perceptual psychology: sensation and perception, and the process of perception (3) Cognitive psychology: concept of cognition, and the process of cognition (4) Personality psychology: character and personality, type and trait, and how to understand personality (5) Learning psychology: concept of learning, learning theories, and the analysis of our behavior (6) Developmental psychology: concept of development, identity formation, adolescence, and puberty (7) Social psychology: human relation and health In each item above, students will learn basic concepts and terms, and theories. Students are expected to apply materials in this course to their own experience.
books: Nakajou, S.(2014) Ningen Rikai no tame no Shinrigaku. Kitaoojishobou.(Psychology for Undeestanding human being.)
requiredKnowledge: We will emphasis on listening attitude. In the lecture, there will be many abstract explanations. So it is important for students to apply the lectures to their daily experience.
